snippet.description:
When should college students start thinking seriously about the Civil Services Examination? At Jesus and Mary College, University of Delhi, Nishat Sir, Sociology Faculty at LevelUp IAS and mentor to 240+ rankers, discusses the realities of UPSC preparation and the importance of having clarity about one's goals. He explains the three stages of the examination, the range of civil services available and the diverse backgrounds of candidates competing for limited vacancies. He also encourages students to learn from previous aspirants and begin focused preparation around the start of their third year.

For Rs.50,000 Scholarship: https://www.levelupias.com/scholarship-test-for-upsc-gs-foundation/

Join our free 10-day bootcamp for UPSC beginners.
https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-aarambh/
